ai_summary: **Executive Summary: India Tourism Development Corporation Ltd. (ITDC) Annual Report & AGM Notice**  India Tourism Development Corporation Ltd. (ITDC) has announced its 61st Annual General Meeting to approve the FY2025-26 financial results, highlighted by a proposed dividend of 29.5% (₹2.95 per share) aggregating approximately ₹25.30 crore, signaling positive financial performance and a substantial return to shareholders. The document confirms compliance with SEBI listing regulations, outlines routine corporate governance matters including director appointments and virtual AGM procedures with e-voting. No immediate red flags are identified regarding the company's operational or financial standing, though it notes the ongoing process of transferring unclaimed dividends and shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF).
